body: U6, the last unit, opened as PR 200, branch docs/handoff-skills, commit 2e3100ab, from main at 2dfcc477. Not merged; CI in flight. Four files: skills/debrief/SKILL.md, skills/preflight/SKILL.md, test/contract/skills.test.ts, test/hooks/stop-gate-ledger-presence.test.ts. No CRITICAL and no HIGH; all fifteen conformance obligations met.U+000AU+000ARECEIPTS AS REPORTED. node --test test/contract/skills.test.ts exit 0, 12 pass, 0 fail. typecheck exit 0. npm test 814 pass, 0 fail, both known intermittents passing on the first run. Red on parent for the expected reason: AssertionError, expected the debrief sequence to pass park_thread.landed. Inertness mutation: removing the park_thread.landed reference from the debrief skill turned skill.debrief-passes-both-hand-off-fields red and nothing else, and the revert restored the file byte-identical.U+000AU+000Askill.preflight-resumes-before-it-asks-anything was already green on the parent because U1 had removed the focus steps. It is a regression guard, not a red-on-parent proof; the unit's red-on-parent obligation rests on the debrief test alone. This is the third time in this ladder a red-on-parent prediction in the plan was stale.U+000AU+000AFOUR MORE PLACES THE PLAN WAS WRONG. The debrief sequence ends at 8, not the 9 the plan claims; the file has had 7 steps since 3d3148fe and the plan's own replacement arithmetic nets +1, which its next sentence contradicts. Task 6 step 4b asserts no existing test covers the sessions/U+003Cid>/ path shape, but U7's PR 195 already landed hook.stop-gate-clears-on-a-session-entry-for-the-held-thread; the new test was redirected to drive the real log_session_event tool, binding the tool's actual write path to the gate's matcher, and both reviewers confirmed it is not a duplicate. The plan's readSkillFile('debrief') signature is wrong: the real helper takes an absolute path and returns an object with relPath and content. And the plan's prescribed skill wording fails the project's own skill censuses in two places, which means it was written without running them.U+000AU+000ANOT VERIFIED. The installed plugin's behaviour was not exercised. This machine runs a separate cached build at version 5.0.0, so these source edits change nothing in a live session until a reinstall, which was deliberately not attempted. That is carried as a Not verified line in the PR body rather than claimed.
